intro.001 ARBOL: The ancients told us that the world is shaped like a Great Tree. So immense that everything that exists fits within its trunk.
intro.002 GUARDIANES: And on each of its branches lives a different tribe, with stories and traditions as unique as they are special.
intro.003 CELEBRACION: These branches are so grand that they are revered as Sacred Trees. Each one holds a creative power that keeps the balance.
intro.004 ELEMENTOS: They also told us that we were born from the Tree of Life, when its guardians took the elements and used them to create us.
intro.005 RAMA: But one day, it began to dry up, crack, and break. That’s when the adventure began.
intro.006 VIAJE: And so, for thousands of years, we have lived in peace, making the most of what the Great Tree gives us —
intro.007 FIN: visiting tribes and discovering how to save each of the Sacred Trees.

introMaya.slide1Text: The Sacred Macaw welcomes you. The Mayan branch has lost its shine and needs a brave seeker to restore its colors.
introMaya.slide2Alt: Macaw pointing toward the mission path
introMaya.slide2Text: Accept the mission, register, and follow the clues to awaken the guardians and save the Sacred Tree.
